mapper.sql: m.message_id, m.order_no, m.from_user_id, m.to_user_id, m.content, m.is_read, m.create_time
mapper.select: select , fu.nick_name as from_user_name, tu.nick_name as to_user_name from campus_message m left join sys_user fu on fu.user_id = m.from_user_id left join sys_user tu on tu.user_id = m.to_user_id where m.order_no = #{orderNo} order by m.create_time asc, m.message_id asc

select t.order_no as orderNo, t.last_content as lastContent, t.last_time as lastTime, t.unread as unread, o.status as orderStatus, o.total_amount as totalAmount, o.user_id as buyerId, bu.nick_name as buyerName, (select count(*) from campus_order_item oi where oi.order_no = t.order_no) as itemCount from ( select x.order_no as order_no, (select content from campus_message m2 where m2.order_no = x.order_no order by m2.create_time desc, m2.message_id desc limit 1) as last_content, max(x.create_time) as last_time, sum(case when x.i_am_receiver = 1 and x.is_read = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as unread from ( select order_no, create_time, is_read, 0 as i_am_receiver from campus_message where from_user_id = #{userId} union all select order_no, create_time, is_read, 1 as i_am_receiver from campus_message where to_user_id = #{userId} ) x group by x.order_no order by last_time desc limit #{offset}, #{limit} ) t left join campus_order o on o.order_no = t.order_no left join sys_user bu on bu.user_id = o.user_id order by t.last_time desc
select count(*) from campus_message where to_user_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0
select count(*) from campus_message where order_no = #{orderNo} and to_user_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0

select user_id from campus_order where order_no = #{orderNo} union select distinct p.seller_id from campus_order_item oi join campus_product p on p.id = oi.product_id where oi.order_no = #{orderNo} and p.seller_id is not null
mapper.insert: insert into campus_message (order_no, from_user_id, to_user_id, content, is_read) values (#{orderNo}, #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{content}, #{isRead})
mapper.update: update campus_message set is_read = 1 where order_no = #{orderNo} and to_user_id = #{userId} and is_read = 0
